# Awesome Agent Trading

> Curated directory of AI trading agents and tools for US equities and options, global crypto and DeFi, and prediction markets.

## Resources

- Searchable directory: https://laplaceagent.com/awesome-agent-trading/
- Downloadable directory data: https://laplaceagent.com/awesome-agent-trading/projects.json
- Repository: https://github.com/laplace0x/awesome-agent-trading
- Full directory: https://github.com/laplace0x/awesome-agent-trading/blob/main/README.md
- Featured data subset: https://github.com/laplace0x/awesome-agent-trading/blob/main/data/projects.json
- Contribution criteria: https://github.com/laplace0x/awesome-agent-trading/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Categories

- Trading Agents: agent decision and execution systems; experimental and source-available projects are labeled.
- Broker & Exchange Integrations: official broker MCP services and exchange APIs, including Alpaca and Robinhood.
- MCP Servers & Agent Skills: tool integrations and skills for supported clients, including OpenClaw.
- Prediction Markets: Polymarket, Kalshi, CLIs, SDKs, and simulation tools.
- Research & Backtesting: financial research agents, strategy engines, and backtest/paper/live runtimes.
- Data, Wallets & Risk Infrastructure: market data, wallets, execution controls, identity, and payments.

## Starting points

- Alpaca MCP Server: https://github.com/alpacahq/alpaca-mcp-server
- Alpaca Skills: https://github.com/alpacahq/alpaca-skills
- Robinhood Agentic Trading: https://robinhood.com/us/en/support/articles/agentic-trading-overview/
- OpenAlice: https://github.com/TraderAlice/OpenAlice
- Polymarket CLI: https://github.com/Polymarket/polymarket-cli
- Lumibot: https://github.com/Lumiwealth/lumibot
- Coinbase AgentKit: https://github.com/coinbase/agentkit

## Interpretation

Account eligibility, venue availability, and data access vary. Research, backtesting, paper trading, dry-run, and live execution are distinct modes. Listings are not performance endorsements. New reviewed data entries include license sources and documentation-review dates; missing metadata on older entries means not reviewed. The JSON file is a featured subset, not the entire directory.
